row.evidence: PandaDoc's SSO implementation article gives availability as the Enterprise plan (Business only via a paid SSO add-on) and says PandaDoc supports both SCIM 1.1 and SCIM 2.0, configured inside the SSO settings.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Changed since June: SCIM is no longer 1.1 only; PandaDoc now supports SCIM 2.0 with group-based provisioning (group to licence, workspace and role), and existing SCIM 1.1 setups keep working. The SSO article lists Business with SSO as a paid add-on ($20/month or $240/year per seat), while the plan comparison article shows SSO on Enterprise only; whether the Business SSO add-on also unlocks SCIM is not stated, so scim_plan stays Enterprise. Prices from PandaDoc's help-centre plan comparison: Starter $19/user/mo annual ($35 monthly), Business $49 annual ($65 monthly), Enterprise Contact Us. The pricing page itself (pandadoc.com/pricing) returned a Vercel security checkpoint (HTTP 429) to every fetch, so it is not cited. PandaDoc has no deactivated-user state: deprovisioning deletes the user and transfers their documents to the workspace owner. The Okta OIN app is SAML/SWA only; PandaDoc's own guides use Okta's generic SCIM 1.1 test app and an Entra non-gallery app. The public REST API (/public/v1/users, workspaces/members) can create and list users and manage workspace membership and roles.

plans.name: Free eSign
plans.notes: API available on all plans, including Free (25 API-created documents per month).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: SSO is a paid add-on on Business ($20/month or $240/year per seat) per the SSO article; the plan comparison shows SSO on Enterprise only. Whether SCIM comes with the add-on is not stated.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Account audit log (CSV download, last 30 days) is Enterprise-only; no audit-log API is documented.

auth.token_source: Customer-generated 256-bit key pasted into Settings > Single Sign On > SCIM API Token (prefixed with 'Bearer'); the SCIM Base URL is generated on save

endpoints.notes: Endpoints are not listed. SCIM 1.1 and SCIM 2.0 are both offered; SCIM 2.0 adds group-based provisioning.

operations.notes: Update is documented (role, licence, workspace, name and email sync) but PUT vs PATCH is not stated. 'Deactivate' (active=false) results in deletion because there is no deactivated state.

deprovision.data_retained: Documents and templates transfer to the workspace owner; a returning user is provisioned as a new user.
deprovision.notes: Deleting a user leaves a spare licence for reuse; the paid seat count is only reduced when the account owner lowers it in Billing. Removing a user from one mapped group only removes that workspace.

custom.how: Custom attributes and group custom attributes are not supported via SCIM.

attributes.notes: No SCIM attribute schema is published; the docs say name and email (plus role, licence and workspace from group rules) are synced. Provisioning rules match on a user field or a group field (Group ID or Group Name). SAML attributes are Email, FirstName and LastName.

roles.how: Provisioning rules in the SSO settings assign licence, workspaces and role, either the same for all new users or by user/group field value; with SCIM 2.0, group membership controls role, licence and workspace.

limitations.text: No deactivated-user state: deprovisioning deletes the account; returning users are created as new users.
Custom attributes and group custom attributes are not supported via SCIM.
Removing an employee from the IdP alone blocks SSO but does not delete the PandaDoc profile unless the IdP is mapped to set active false or delete.
Accounts downgraded from Enterprise may not be able to remove the SSO configuration from the UI.

auth.notes: API keys are issued per workspace and inherit the owner's permissions; organisation-level user operations need an Organization Admin's key. OAuth applications are a paid add-on on Business and Enterprise per the API feature table.

capabilities.notes: Workspaces act as groups (add/remove member). No organisation-level delete or deactivate user endpoint was found; Remove Member works per workspace.

endpoints.purpose: List users in the organisation (org admin)
Create user with licence, workspaces and roles (org admin)
Add existing user to a workspace

webhooks_user_events.notes: The complete webhook events reference lists document, recipient, quote, template and content-library events only.

audit_log_api.notes: The account audit log (Enterprise) is a CSV download in Settings; the API offers document audit trails and API logs, not the account audit log.

rate_limits.text: Per-user limits in requests per minute over a 60-second sliding window, varying by operation (e.g. List, Status, Delete 2000 RPM); sandbox keys 10 RPM; 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: API keys are scoped to one workspace except an Organization Admin's key for organisation-level operations.

okta.notes: The OIN PandaDoc app's functionality marks only SAML and SWA. PandaDoc's own SCIM guide uses Okta's generic 'SCIM 1.1 Test App (Header Auth)'.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT; PandaDoc's SCIM guide uses a 'Create your own application' non-gallery app with the SCIM base URL.

onelogin.notes: PandaDoc's OneLogin guide uses the generic SAML Test Connector (Advanced) with rules mapping users to roles and workspaces via SAML attributes; OneLogin's own catalogue was not checked.
